name: Stephen
source:
One of the senior members of the literature club, Stephen is a composed and adultlike student. A faithful member of the club since his first year, he's grown accustomed to the club's dynamic under Victoria's leadership. A long-time friend of William, the duo is often seen joking around as if they were brothers.
